name: TraceForge
description: Signal paths, PCB tools and deterministic manufacturing packages for KiCad 10
description_full: TraceForge combines signal path timing, trace cleanup, rounded track corners, component rotation, automatic reference/value placement on selected text layers, selection-based placement/routing Layout Clone with automatic matching, rotated target transforms, interactive result preview, target-net remapping and no schematic hierarchy, via tools including live via-in-pad and stitching-cleanup scanners, RF via fencing, BGA fanout and live net visualization, a click-to-focus Unrouted connection navigator and saved stackup/profile routing geometry in one PCB Editor panel. The Manufacturing tab reviews saved projects and builds PCBWay or PCBPower deliverable packages. PCB editing reads the live board through KiCad 10's pcbnew bindings. This PCM package is for Windows; the separate macOS installer is a testing preview. See the project homepage for setup and known limits. Version 0.18.1 adds combined LCSC/JLCPCB component research, horizontal parametric filters, independent supplier stock/prices and Basic/Extended classification, CAD import handoff, reference-scoped metadata assignment, BOM purchase costing with MOQ/multiples, compatible in-stock passive assignment and Basic-part optimization. Visible scanning and assignment progress, cancellation, PCB focus and Layout Clone preview fixes are included.
